mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential construction, which correlates with improving consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through elevated economic activity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST 3-month change is positive, or the Rank IC between HOUST 3-month change and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.5% (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, which produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below -0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint positive 3-month changes in GDP (GDPC1) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% indicate robust economic growth with stable inflation, supporting corporate earnings expansion and positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1_3m_change > 0 and CPIAUCSL_3m_change > 0.5, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%) triggers aggressive monetary policy responses that increase real interest rates and equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in high inflation periods is below -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate capital expenditure and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO 3-month change is positive, or the Rank IC for INDPRO is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing short-term equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS 3-month change is positive, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS 3-month change and 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real S&P 500 value (RSAFS) indicates strong market momentum, which typically persists and yields positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through continued investor confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS 6-month change is positive, or the Rank IC for RSAFS 6-month change and 60-day returns is below 0.03.
